items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: When I go up there Claude Luter asked me to play the sax, to borrow the saxophone, his soprano saxophone.

ctx.x: Could you talk about yourself and Sidney Bechet in France, whenever you were -

Yeah, I'll give you the one instance that I remember real well about Sidney Bechet. Which is, if it's not true Jacques Butler told me. When I was living with Henry Goodwin's mother - see, [ ], 19th Street and Seventh Avenue, I was living with her. He wasn't there but I was living with her, his mother. So she knew Sidney 'cause Sidney, they stayed at her house when he visited New York at one time. So she knew that I was going, so she said "Be sure to go around to see Sidney".
